provenance.source: new: 2026-10-24 real-host bug. OpenCode 2.1.x drew the ; menu over the conversation in the top rows, a fixed 88 cells wide, and Tab, Down, Enter and Escape all went to OpenCode: Enter sent the raw ;t to the model. Rows are read off the screen next to OpenCode's prompt box (harness/murmo_harness/validation/integration.py opencode_menu_rows)
provenance.author: murmo

cases.note: Typing ; at a word start opens the menu next to the prompt box and the query filters it. Setup's starter murmo.toml adds its own shortcuts, so the query names the project one.
Down moves the selection inside the menu (it used to open OpenCode's subagent picker) and Tab inserts the row's expansion in place of the typed ;query.
Enter in the menu picks the selected row like Tab and never sends: OpenCode used to submit the raw ;t (fixtures/menu/enter.json).
In a session the prompt sits at the bottom under the transcript; the menu still opens next to it and Tab inserts.
Escape closes the menu and leaves the typed ;hp; it used to go to OpenCode and leave the overlay up.
